name: Y-F5-competitive-normalized-multi-hop-recurrent-test
mechanistic_hypothesis: F4 unnormalized multi-edge activation causes excess false positives in learned recurrent composition; trainable competitive source-attention normalizes each message aggregation and suppresses spurious paths without programmed equality or OR traversal.

design.model_architecture: Y-F4 22-parameter RecurrentComposer + 1 trainable source-attention temperature, identical 576-byte native resident state
design.training: 150 Adam lr .055 full-batch steps, clipped grad norm 10; same optimizer budget for matched F4 unnormalized
controls: matched unnormalized 22-parameter F4 trained from scratch on same training graph states

disclosure: Input 16-bit public entity features and 3 message rounds are engineered; candidate lacks explicit coded equality and OR-traversal. Scientific F3 external source first-use still blocked. Negative outcome is valid and will not be tuned to pass.
